Name: Golden Animal Cracker Extractor
Author: zombifier
Description:
This mod adds a new tool purchasable at Qi's Walnut Shop for 10 Gems that can remove a Golden Animal Cracker from a farm animal or a fish pond that ate one. The tool must be loaded with Diamonds or Prismatic Shards and consumes 1 per use.

To use, simply load the tool with Diamonds or Prismatic Shards and click on the animal or fish pond you want to spit out the Animal Cracker that you fed them, you monster.

Goes well with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]﻿: Never feel guilty about 'butchering' your animals that were fed crackers again - just remove the crackers before sending them to the shadow realm!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed[/url]﻿: Adds a late game method of making animal crackers, among other features.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16879]Better Pigs[/url]﻿: Allows feeding pigs golden crackers and make them benefit from the bonus.
[/list]Source code:
